answer.text:
For high-performance gaming in India, the KARNAGE Blink and Xeus Gaming Mouse offer tri-mode wireless connectivity with 1000Hz polling rates, lightweight designs, and advanced customization for competitive gameplay +1.
1. KARNAGE Blink Tri-Mode Wireless Gaming Mouse
Connectivity: Wired, 2.4GHz wireless, and Bluetooth
Sensor: Pixart 3311 esports-grade optical sensor
Polling Rate: 1000Hz for ultra-responsive actions
DPI Range: Up to 16,000 DPI with customization through software
Weight & Ergonomics: Ultra-light 60g, comfortable for long gaming sessions
Switches: HUANO 50M click lifespan for durability
Battery Life: 500mAh internal battery, up to 70 hours of gameplay
Custom Features: Customizable lift-off distance, programmable DPI levels, macros, and RGB lighting via software
Warranty: 2 years in India
Ideal For: Competitive gamers seeking high precision and versatile connectivity
2. Xeus 8K Superlight Tri-Mode Gaming Mouse Cybeart India
Connectivity: Tri-mode support (Wired, Bluetooth, 2.4GHz wireless)
Weight: Extremely lightweight at 39g, designed for speed and agility
Software Support: Cybeart Node software allows DPI adjustment, button remapping, macros, performance tweaking, and onboard memory for multiple profiles
Ideal Use: Suitable for pro/competitive gaming, casual gaming, and professional work requiring precise mouse control
3. Other Options in India
Multiple high-performance wireless mice with 1000Hz polling rate are available on Amazon India. Examples include:
EvoFox Phantom Air Wireless, Tri-Mode, 12,800 DPI, ultra-light, RGB lighting
Zebronics Viper 100W Premium Wireless, Tri-Mode, Huano switches, up to 8000 DPI
Ant Esports Virtus100 and GM333 with RGB customization and high polling rates
Selection Tip: Check the product page for weight, DPI, sensor type, and available software features to match your preferred gaming style.
Buying Considerations
Weight & Grip Style: Lighter mice like Xeus or KARNAGE Blink provide faster movement; heavier mice may offer better control for some users.
Polling Rate & Resolution: 1000Hz ensures minimal input lag; higher DPI allows precise tracking.
Customization: Macro support, RGB lighting, and software profiles enhance competitive advantage.
Battery Management: Look for long battery life or fast-charging support if using wireless modes extensively.
These mice are currently available for purchase in India through platforms like Amazon India with EMI and offers, making them accessible for different budgets +2.
